text: Here you and I ... came together ... just now and did not say one word to one another all the time, and it was only afterwards you began staring at me like a wild creature, and I at you. Is that loving? Is that how one human being should meet another? It’s hideous, that’s what it is!” “Yes!” she assented sharply and hurriedly. I was positively astounded by the promptitude of this “Yes.” So the same thought may have been straying through her mind when she was staring at me just before.
